init.description: Adjust the watering durations for this zone.

water_now.name: Water now
water_now.description: Start watering immediately for a given duration. If no duration is given, the zone default duration is used.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration in seconds (clamped to the zone max duration).

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stop watering immediately and turn the target entity off.

refill_reservoir.name: Refill reservoir
refill_reservoir.description: Reset the tracked remaining reservoir volume back to full capacity (reservoir_volume_l).

add_schedule.name: Add schedule
add_schedule.description: Add a new irrigation schedule to the zone.

time.name: Time
time.description: Time of day to start watering.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days of the week when the schedule runs (0 = Monday, 6 = Sunday).

id.name: Schedule ID
id.description: ID of the schedule to update.

time.name: Time
time.description: New time of day to start watering.

days.name: Days
days.description: New days of the week (0 = Monday, 6 = Sunday).

id.name: Schedule ID
id.description: ID of the schedule to remove.

set_schedules.name: Set schedules
set_schedules.description: Replace all schedules of the zone with a new list.

schedules.name: Schedules
schedules.description: Full list of schedules to set.

set_zone_options.name: Set zone options
set_zone_options.description: Update optional zone settings (default duration, flow rate, number of pots, reservoir volume and the pH gate for up to two independent reservoirs).

default_duration.name: Default duration
default_duration.description: Default watering duration in seconds, used by water_now when no duration is given. Must not exceed the zone's max_duration.

flow_rate_lph.name: Flow rate per pot
flow_rate_lph.description: Watering flow rate PER POT, in liters per hour (multiplied by number_of_pots for the total volume shown on the card).

number_of_pots.name: Number of pots
number_of_pots.description: Number of pots watered by the zone (used for per-pot volume).

ph_entity_id.name: pH sensor
ph_entity_id.description: Entity id of a pH sensor. When set, SCHEDULED runs only start while its reading is within ph_min/ph_max (water_now always ignores this). Send an empty string to disable the gate.

ph_min.name: Minimum pH
ph_min.description: Minimum pH (0-14) that allows a scheduled run to start.

ph_max.name: Maximum pH
ph_max.description: Maximum pH (0-14) that allows a scheduled run to start.

ec_entity_id.name: EC sensor
ec_entity_id.description: Entity id of an EC (conductivity) sensor. Display-only: it never gates a run, it only feeds the card's EC badge. Send an empty string to clear it.

ph_entity_id_2.name: R2 pH sensor
ph_entity_id_2.description: Entity id of a pH sensor for a SECOND, independent reservoir (e.g. one pump/outlet feeding two tanks). When set, SCHEDULED runs only start while BOTH reservoirs read within their own range. Send an empty string to disable.

ph_min_2.name: R2 minimum pH
ph_min_2.description: Minimum pH (0-14) for the second reservoir.

ph_max_2.name: R2 maximum pH
ph_max_2.description: Maximum pH (0-14) for the second reservoir.

ec_entity_id_2.name: R2 EC sensor
ec_entity_id_2.description: Entity id of an EC sensor for the second reservoir. Display-only. Send an empty string to clear it.
